title: Xer Taaqeh Enigma
intro: caylale amoyti, qaadik yan amoytiinul barkat le, xer baaxok temeete malika edde anuk baxsale gexkalit kaat garaye. Amoyti yallih cayla kee wale yaybulleem faxak sugeeh, wakti kee arac madqooqi sadah yan qajabsitan tekkooka gexsiisak suge. atu ta assakat le tekkookah addatino taybulleem duuddaa?
clues: Ambullee sinni ginoona lowsiisoonu kee caacay amrisaanamih dudda edde anuk, amoyti kaxxa cayla yeceen.
Tama amoyti ayroyta qibaadah tan gaddale malikah xaagu hirgeeh, cokmi buxal tet arcibisuh yirgiqeh.
Malika tamaateemik afal, amoyti baxxole doolatak tet qaxmeqe reedâ daffeyna baahaanamih fayxi lem qaddoyse.
caylale jinni xayyooweh duyye gacsuh amoyti isi mala buxak ugtaamak afal.
Takkay ikkah, Divine Scripture wagsiisak kaxxa ixxiga leh yan num, sissik retrieval, taama inki intih addat gaba kalteh.
tet gufte wak, amoyti amriseh too duyye milaagimtuh malika mesenkaca kee mabla gibbatuh is ellecaboh daala gufte wak.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
